question: Where was the Global Fintech Fest (GFF) 2025 held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jio World Convention Centre, Mumbai**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Global Fintech Fest (GFF)** is one of the largest fintech conferences in the world, and the **2025** edition is scheduled to be held at the **Jio World Convention Centre, Mumbai**.
 
• The event is organized by the **Payments Council of India (PCI)**, the **National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)**, and the **Fintech Convergence Council (FCC)**.
 
• The **2025** edition follows the massive success of the **2024** fest, which took place from **August 28 to 30, 2024**, at the same venue.
 
• The primary objective of the fest is to provide a premier global platform for **fintech founders**, **policymakers**, **regulators**, and **investors** to collaborate and shape the future of the financial ecosystem.
 
• The **Jio World Convention Centre** in **Mumbai** has become the permanent home for this event due to its world-class infrastructure and its location in India’s **financial capital**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Growth of GFF:** Since its inception, the **Global Fintech Fest** has grown significantly, attracting over **1,000+ speakers** and **800+ exhibitors** from more than **100 countries**.
 
• **Significance of Mumbai:** As the **Financial Capital of India**, **Mumbai** serves as the hub for the **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)**, major **public and private sector banks**, and the headquarters of numerous fintech unicorns.
 
• **Role of NPCI:** The **National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)**, established in **2008**, is the backbone of retail payments in India. It is responsible for the revolutionary **Unified Payments Interface (UPI)**, which is a major theme at every GFF.
 
• **Themes and Innovation:** The fest focuses on critical themes such as **Artificial Intelligence (AI)** in finance, **Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI)**, **sustainable finance**, and **regulatory technology (RegTech)**.
 
• **India’s Fintech Adoption:** India currently boasts the world’s **highest fintech adoption rate** at **87%**, which is significantly higher than the global average of **64%**, making the GFF a central event for the global economy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Jio World Convention Centre:** Located in the **Bandra Kurla Complex (BKC)**, it is an iconic landmark in **Mumbai** that spans over **1,00,000 square meters**, designed to host international summits and cultural events.
 
• **Global Recognition:** The **Global Fintech Fest** has previously seen participation from high-profile leaders, including the **Prime Minister of India** and the **Governor of the Reserve Bank of India**, highlighting its importance in national policy-making.
 
• **Date of GFF 2025:** The **2025** edition is slated to take place between **September 3 and September 5, 2025**, continuing the tradition of being a landmark annual event.
